scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n landing,user,creator -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix landingpage run dev" "npm --prefix user-side run dev" "npm --prefix creator-side run dev"
scripts.dev:creator: npm --prefix creator-side run dev
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix landingpage ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix user-side ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix creator-side ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.build:creator: npm --prefix creator-side run build
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:landing && npm run build:user && npm run build:creator
scripts.build: npm run install:apps && npm run build:apps && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.lint: npm --prefix landingpage run lint && npm --prefix user-side run lint && npm --prefix creator-side run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix landingpage run test && npm --prefix user-side run test && npm --prefix creator-side run test
